ImageCamera.description:
A camera stacked under the first on the Images page, and how its row looks.

The first camera's choices are the set's own ``image_*`` fields; each
further camera keeps the same choices here, under the same names without
``image_``. Its region of interest is ``image_rois[device]``, as the
first camera's is.

zscale.description: The z scale: per tile, shared by the row, or fixed.
zscale.title: Zscale

hits.description: The X-ray-hit filter applied to each shot.
hits.title: Hits

centre.description: Centre each shot on its peak above this threshold (1 or more: counts; below 1: a fraction of the peak); empty: not centred.
centre.title: Centre

channels.description: The row's scope channels (from 0), overlaid on each trace tile; a device with one channel reads it whatever is named.
channels.title: Channels

xmin.description: A trace row's x window, low side; empty: no limit.
xmin.title: Xmin

xmax.description: A trace row's x window, high side; empty: no limit.
xmax.title: Xmax

description:
Every control of the Plot and Images pages, each with its default.

A set follows its viewer from scan to scan: the scan last opened under it
(``day``, ``scan``) is where it reopens, and the axes, fits, filters and
image choices apply to whichever scan is open.
